policies.title: Economy Class Mandate
policies.description: All employees must travel economy class for flights under 6 hours. Business class is permitted for flights over 6 hours for Senior Manager level and above.
exceptions: VP level and above may book business class on any flight
No economy availability within 24 hours of departure

policies.title: Advance Purchase Requirement
policies.description: Domestic flights must be booked at least 7 days in advance. International flights must be booked at least 14 days in advance to qualify for reimbursement without approval.
exceptions: Emergency travel approved by department head

policies.title: Per Diem Hotel Cap
policies.description: Hotel costs are capped at $200/night for domestic travel and $250/night for international travel. Exceptions require manager approval.
exceptions: Conference hotels when conference rate is the lowest available
Cities with documented high-cost exceptions (NYC, SF, London, Tokyo)

policies.title: Preferred Hotel Partners
policies.description: Employees must book from the preferred hotel partner list (Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, IHG) when available. Booking outside preferred partners requires justification.
exceptions: No preferred partner available within 2 miles of destination

policies.title: Meal Allowance
policies.description: Daily meal allowance is $75 for domestic travel and $100 for international travel. Receipts required for any individual meal over $25.

policies.title: Ground Transportation Policy
policies.description: Use of rideshare (Uber/Lyft) or company-approved cab vendors is preferred. Personal vehicle use is reimbursed at IRS mileage rate ($0.67/mile). Airport parking must be economy/off-site unless unavailable.

policies.title: Visa Application Process
policies.description: Visa applications must be initiated at least 4 weeks before travel. The travel desk handles all visa applications. Employees must submit passport copy, invitation letter, and accommodation proof.
exceptions: Visa on arrival destinations require only standard documentation
Emergency visa processing available with department head approval at additional cost

policies.title: Cancellation and Refund Policy
policies.description: Cancellations must be reported to the travel desk immediately. Non-refundable bookings require department head approval before booking. Unused tickets/credits must be reported to the travel desk within 24 hours.
exceptions: Medical emergencies documented with doctor's note are fully reimbursed
Carrier-initiated cancellations qualify for full refund
